title: Amigo secreto card
summary: The card at the top of the group timeline while an amigo secreto is open or drawn. Before the draw it shows who is in and who is missing, and lets a new member take part or claim their name. After the draw it shows the person you drew, your wish list and theirs.

setupId.description: From the newest setup event in the group.

isParticipant.description: true when this account is a participant or claimed a slot.

drawnUserId.description: From this account's resultEventType message for the current round.

ownWishes.description: This account's wish list, at most wishlistMaxItems.

theirWishes.description: The wish list of the drawn person, decrypted with the key from the result.

redrawn.description: true when a newer round replaced a result this account had seen.

join.effect: A member who is not in: asks the organiser's phone to add them by sending a setup change request as a reply to the setup event. The organiser's phone adds them and publishes.

claimSlot.effect: Shows bipe_amigo_secreto_claim_title with missingNames. The person picks their name with bipe_amigo_secreto_claim. Same request as join, with the slotId.

openResult.effect: Shows bipe_amigo_secreto_you_drew with the drawn person's name and avatar (people-name order of the screens README), theirWishes and bipe_amigo_secreto_secret_footer.

text.description: The idea. A link in it passes the link check of ADR 0076.

addWish.effect: Adds to ownWishes and posts the whole list as a wishEventType event: the list encrypted with this account's wishKey (wishCipher), tagged with its wishTag.

removeWish.effect: Removes it and posts the list again.

notes: A person who joins the group through the group link lands on this card at the top of the group.
Wish lists before the draw: the participant writes them; they are posted once the result with the own wishKey arrives.
Only the person who drew you has your wishKey, so other members see only an encrypted blob from you.
Web chat: shows the card and the wish lists; setup can wait (bipe-chat/bipe#1527 step 6).
